items.title: Louis Armstrong: Jazz Casual Interview, 1964-07-10
items.q: I had never noticed this until I looked them up in Charles Delaunay's discography recently

ctx.x: Chippy Hill, I was played with them. I played with them all. Sippy Wallace. Sippy Wallace, yeah.

You know all of them, J. Well, we did, to, uh, to, uh, play in the Oliver Band and then to go on and play with Fletcher Henderson things, right in the middle of all that, you made such a remarkable series of recordings with a small group, the Louis Armstrong Hot Five, which I'm sure everyone that's listened to jazz all over the world knows of these records, and I was, I had never noticed this until I looked them up in Charles Delaunay's discography recently, and they were all made within a relatively short period…
